name: tr
description: Translates or deletes characters from standard input.

flags.description: Replaces characters of SET1 with the corresponding characters of SET2.
Squeezes repeated characters in SET into one.
Complement: operate on all characters NOT in SET1.

examples.explanation: Removes carriage returns — the standard fix for Windows CRLF line endings.
Squeezes runs of spaces into single spaces.
Keeps only digits, deleting everything else (-c complement, -d delete).

about: tr works on characters only — it cannot handle multi-character strings (use sed for that). It always reads stdin and writes stdout; there is no direct file argument. Character classes like [:upper:] and [:digit:] are supported.
mistakes: Trying tr "old" "new" with multi-character words — tr is strictly character-by-character.
